environment: Windows Sandbox with networking enabled, run as SYSTEM, Edge confirmed by the operator
scope: F2 slice 4a: web categories downloaded from the server, verified by digest, cached for offline use and enforced through the local DNS resolver

package.build: tools/build-msi-fixtures.ps1 -Production (no defines), WiX 5.0.2, version 0.3.0, agent and installer source at 65c0340
package.fault_injection_actions: absent (CustomAction table checked inside Sandbox before install)

categories.build: app/categories.py build_categories from a two-domain UT1-shaped games list (steampowered.com, steamcommunity.com)

checks: production install downloads the games category and blocks it through system DNS
allowed exception and unlisted names resolve upstream
the category is cached in the protected data directory with its published digest
with the backend offline, a service restart keeps blocking from the cache
Edge shows the block page for steamcommunity.com, confirmed by the operator
removal restores NRPT rules, trust and hosts
operator_observation: Edge showed the RSM block page for https://steamcommunity.com/ without a certificate warning
notes: A first attempt failed the offline restart check: the agent persisted a new policy only at the next enforcement tick (15 s), so a restart soon after it arrived lost it. Fixed in 65c0340 with a native contract that uses a 30 s interval
A second attempt failed the preflight because the freshly opened Sandbox had no DNS yet; the host resolved every name. The preflight now retries for 60 s (b20ec39)

Block event log, panel screens and category name on the block page (part 4b)
